items.q: this Bardu Ali (PHONETIC), he and his brother had an act. They used to come there.

ctx.x: So, as you were saying, Chuck?

Well, I was saying about Billy Pierce studio. You see, these fellows -- he became a teacher. That's Buster Newman, see, and then there was these Cotton Club boys like Louis Brown and Stretch Johnson, and even the band leader used to come there, this Bardu Ali (PHONETIC), he and his brother had an act. They used to come there.
Who eventually became Red Foxx's manager.
